evidence.evidence_text: Assuming you have an automated bathroom at home, have a sensor that recognizes when the hot water in the shower opens and when you go into the shower and activates the stereo by playing the music from your favorite playlists and which also recognizes a stop command in case you don't want to listen to music.

coding.rationale: Evidence shows music playback during shower use with an explicit stop command, an optional comfort enhancement benefiting the showering resident while the bathroom is occupied.

responsibility_name: Support a consistent wake-up morning routine

evidence.evidence_text: When the sensor detects that the person gets out of bed, if the time is between 7:30 and 8:30, if the user's smart watch detects the heartbeat between 60 and 80, then the electric coffee machine comes on and the kitchen roller shutter goes up.

coding.rationale: On wake detection within a morning time window the kitchen is prepared for the day, preparing the resident's morning routine in a scheduled context.

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN the user studies AND the TV is on OR the smartphone's social networks are not in stand-by TURN OFF the TV AND enable stand-by mode for social apps.

coding.rationale: While the user studies, media distractions are suppressed so a focused environment is maintained; failure causes distraction discomfort during occupancy.

evidence.evidence_text: When the user enters the bathroom and the time is between 7:00 and 8:00, the light goes on and the tap in the bathtub opens.

coding.rationale: Entering the bathroom in the morning window triggers bath preparation, a scheduled routine readiness outcome; failure is an inconvenience to the resident.

evidence.evidence_text: When the user is in the room, if he says "reading mode" to Alexa or if he sets the reading mode from the smartwatch, then adjust the brightness of the lamp to 2 and set the smartphone to do not disturb

coding.rationale: On explicit reading-mode request while present, lighting and phone interruptions are set to achieve a comfortable undistracted reading state; failure causes reading discomfort.

responsibility_name: wake up reliably in the morning

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN the user NOT switches off the alarm as soon as it starts sounding TURN ON the lights gradually AND RAISE the rolling shutters in successive steps.

coding.rationale: Escalating light and shutter cues when the alarm is not dismissed achieve reliable waking at the scheduled time; failure means the wake-up task is not completed.

responsibility_name: alert occupants to failed door access attempts

evidence.evidence_text: When the fingerprint reader does not recognize the fingerprint, it sends a notification to the mobile phone and rings the bell.

coding.rationale: Unrecognized fingerprint attempts trigger occupant alerts, guarding household awareness of possible unauthorized entry at a door-access threshold event.

responsibility_name: avoid heating while windows are open

evidence.evidence_text: If I open the window and the heating is on, turn off the heating system and notify me with a notification

coding.rationale: Opening a window while heating runs suspends heating and notifies, guarding against energy waste triggered by the window-open threshold event.

evidence.evidence_text: If the fire alarm goes off, or when there is no electricity in the house, turn on the auxiliary lights and initiate an emergency call.

coding.rationale: Auxiliary lighting during fire alarm or power loss protects occupants from harm in the dark; a hazard-event guarding responsibility.

evidence.evidence_text: If the fire alarm goes off, or when there is no electricity in the house, turn on the auxiliary lights and initiate an emergency call.

coding.rationale: Fire alarm or power outage initiates an emergency call summoning help, guarding the household against harm during hazard events.

responsibility_name: Ensure expected deliveries trigger gate access and notification

evidence.evidence_text: When the courier is near, if the user has placed an order online, open the gate and send a message on the mobile

coding.rationale: A courier arrival matching an expected order grants gate access with notification, achieving smooth delivery receipt; failure inconveniences the resident's delivery.

responsibility_name: Ensure only authorised vehicles can open the garage gate

evidence.evidence_text: When a car approaches the entrance gate of the garage of the house, it is identified by a proximity sensor which will automatically trigger an initial recognition check of the car based on the infrared emitted by a specific key. If the first check is unsuccessful, an intelligent camera will scan the license plate trying to match the authorized cars. Once the checks have been carried out, the garage gate will then be opened and the lights inside will be turned on.

coding.rationale: Multi-step vehicle verification before opening the garage gate guards property access so only authorized vehicles enter on arrival; failure is a security breach.

responsibility_name: ensure the garage is closed after parking

evidence.evidence_text: When the car enters the garage and if the parked car does not move for 10 seconds, the garage door will close automatically and the lights will turn on.

coding.rationale: Automatic garage door closure once the parked car is stationary guards the property against being left open; failure risks unauthorized access.

responsibility_name: ensure the garage is lit after parking

evidence.evidence_text: When the car enters the garage and if the parked car does not move for 10 seconds, the garage door will close automatically and the lights will turn on.

coding.rationale: Lighting turns on after the car is parked, achieving a lit garage for the arriving resident; failure is an inconvenience in a dark garage.

responsibility_name: Ensure the water system is shut off and the owner alerted on leakage

evidence.evidence_text: If I turn off the kitchen tap, all the taps in the house are closed and the water meter continues to measure, the house water system is turned off and the user receives a notification on the phone of a possible lost.

coding.rationale: Meter flow with all taps closed indicates a leak, triggering system shutoff and an alert to guard the property from water damage during this hazard event.
